notes: Time-dependent cosmic birefringence search with SPT-3G. Flat-region 95% CL limit: g_agamma < 1.18e-12 GeV^-1 * (m_phi/1e-21 eV), valid for 4.7e-22 eV <= m_phi <= 4.7e-20 eV (periods 1-100 days). Data points computed from this scaling relation at endpoints: at 4.7e-22 eV, g=1.18e-12*0.47=5.546e-13; at 4.7e-20 eV, g=1.18e-12*47=5.546e-11... note the linear mass scaling means limit degrades (increases) with mass. Correcting: at 4.7e-22 eV -> 5.546e-13; at 4.7e-20 eV -> 5.546e-11. The second data point coupling should be 5.546e-11 not 5.546e-14.
